title: Arrays & Nested Paths
subtitle: Line items, addresses, and deep objects
description: How path overrides, array helpers, and field subscriptions work together on nested data.
content: Nested forms are where draft overrides shine. Edit one leaf without cloning the whole tree in your React state.

sections.title: Path grammar
sections.content:
Dot paths with numeric segments for arrays:

• `pricing.basePrice`
• `addresses.0.city`
• `variants.2.sku`

Wildcards in field validators: `addresses.*.postalCode`.
